about: Every URL read: the researcher's list, every other URL an item cites and the pages covering the storm (coverage: liveblog, explainer, ...; from research/weather-sites), with its publisher, how often it is cited and the earliest item citing it. Built by tools/graph-build.mjs from the incident's JSON; every row carries label, source, read and origin. Not a warning service.

rows.holds: The only purpose-built tracker found. A dashboard with two views: weather warnings (a risk map by warning area, a national severity figure, "warnings in my area" by the reader's location, the day's warnings sorted by importance and time) and civil-protection occurrences (a map with markers coloured by state: under way, being resolved, concluding, dispatched; a number on a marker when several share a place; a filter by state). Built with an open map library; data loaded by script.
